analysis.explanation: The document lacks a main landmark, which assistive technologies use to help users quickly navigate to the primary content of the page.
analysis.recommended_fix: Add a <main> element or role="main" to wrap the primary content area of the document body.
verification_steps: Verify using an accessibility scanner that the missing main landmark error is resolved.
Navigate the page with a screen reader to confirm the main landmark is announced correctly.
Perform manual testing to ensure the primary content is properly enclosed.
